denial.premise_measurement: Two functions, four builds, plus a placement control. `opt_strength_reduction off` produced a byte-identical object on fn_800D8BCC (real 124, multiset 4t, fuzzy 96.6977%, unchanged) and on DTextInitColorRamp (insns 51/52, real 15, unchanged), while `optimization_level 0` at the same position moved DTextInitColorRamp to insns 51/50, real 53.
